text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —New Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From the start of winter break through 
the first three days of the New Year, many 
head back to their hometowns. The usually 
lively academy now feels utterly 
deserted."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That said, I'm responsible for an 
Umamusume entering the crucial Classic 
year this year. I can't just laze around 
sleeping through New Year's.
choice_data_list: Alright, back to work, back to work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While reviewing last year's race results 
and training logs, I gradually flesh out 
the training plan for this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, what Admire Vega is taking on 
is the royal, most punishing path: the 
Classic Triple Crown. No amount of 
preparation could ever be too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With those feelings in mind, I was 
eagerly pushing forward with my work, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrr~)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I had made sure to bring all my work 
tools, I completely forgot to prepare 
meals. I'm even out of instant food 
stocks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clinging to a glimmer of hope, I checked 
the nearby shopping street, but being New 
Year's Day, not a single shop was open.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega, who had dutifully returned 
it, was dressed in her jersey, cheeks 
slightly flushed. It seemed she had been 
hard at work training, even on New Year's 
Day.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Because we ran out of sports drink 
powder.
choice_data_list:
It's a lifesaver that convenience stores 
are open even on New Year's Day, huh.

It's a lifesaver that convenience stores 
are open even on New Year's Day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's right. You help me out... always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her say "as always" makes me 
realize. ...She most likely doesn't go 
back to her family home, even during the 
New Year holidays.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering Admire Vega's circumstances, 
perhaps that can't be helped, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'm going to go finish up 
some shopping.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we ran into each other, I suggested 
getting Admire Vega's shopping done along 
with my own lunch run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They pushed back quite a bit, but I 
insisted they leave it to the adults and 
held my ground—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to include a little souvenir 
along with it.
choice_data_list: A hot snack that'll perk you right up.
Instant soup that should help you relax.

Sweets that look like they'd sharpen the 
mind

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?
choice_data_list: Might as well. It's cold today, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Admire Vega's lead as she began 
eating silently, I took a bite of my 
piping hot meat bun. However—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What, are you okay? ...Can you not handle 
hot food?
choice_data_list: M-Maybe... Are you doing all right, Ayabe?
M-Maybe... Are you doing all right, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like I particularly... mind hot 
food or anything."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I hear it's best to eat it without 
letting it touch the tip of your tongue. 
...Not that I'd know, though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we happily enjoyed the 
delicious meat buns.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't there something extra mixed in 
here?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What is that...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well... hello.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's getting chilly, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(It feels so chilly... maybe because the 
other girls aren't around.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah, come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...So warm.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh... Sweets?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You really didn't need to do that, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... Whew.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...So fluffy...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Hum... Hum... Hum...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Alright, just waiting for it to dry now...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Fluffy...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (So fluffy...!!)
